newsitem.title: FRANCE: Canal Plus hits year low.
newsitem.headline: Canal Plus hits year low.

text.p: Shares in Canal Plus fell to a year low on Friday after the Spanish parliament approved legislation ending the monopoly enjoyed by Canal Plus and its Spanish allies in broadcasting soccer matches, brokers said.

They said the new law means Canal Plus and its partners Antena 3 and TV3 will have share the broadcasts with new rival Telefonica. "It's clearly bad news for Canal Plus. Spain is its second market after France," a broker said.
The share was down 2.19 percent at 983 francs at 1251 GMT. It hit a year low earlier of 977 francs. Its previous low, reached last week, was 988 francs.
